title: The Best Vegetarian Stuffing Ever
description:
“In my family, stuffing came from a box. But when I was invited to a Thanksgiving dinner and asked to bring
stuffing, I figured being the casserole queen and all showing up with a fake casserole would be a little, um, bad?
So, I came up with this recipe, headed over to my friend's house with the ingredients on Thursday morning and
crossed my fingers it would turn out okay. It was so much better than okay. I do have to give credit where credit is
due: my friend butter.”
directions: Melt butter in a large saute pan over medium heat. When the butter is melted add one tablespoon of the
sage, the onion, celery and the carrot. When the onions become translucent, add the garlic, apples and salt
After the apples have cooked for about 2 minutes, pour the vegetable broth into the pan, season with the
cayenne and more salt and pepper as needed, and let the mixture saute for 1 to 2 more minutes.
Tear the bread into approximately 1/2-inch squares and place in a 2-3/4-quart casserole dish.
Remove the mixture from the stove and pour it over the bread. Mix well and bake uncovered at 350ºF for
about 45 minutes to an hour. For best results, stir at least once.
